storySection.heading: Empowering Students in Nampally Since 2014
storySection.paragraph1: Afsar Educational Academy was established with a singular mission: to offer accessible, top-tier coaching for students in Nampally, Aghapura, and surrounding areas in Hyderabad.
storySection.paragraph2: Recognizing that every student learns at their own pace, we combine traditional board coaching (SSC & Intermediate) with flexible Open Schooling options (TOSS, BOSSE, NIOS). This allows working students, gap-year candidates, and regular schoolgoers to achieve their academic targets seamlessly.
storySection.quoteBox: "Right Foundation at the Right Age — Choose a future-ready learning environment with strong academics and all-round development."
storySection.founderVisionDescription: Mr. Afsar Shareef (M.Sc, B.Ed), with over 15 years of academic leadership, personally oversees classroom instruction and student progress to maintain strict quality standards.

pillarsSection.heading: The 4 Pillars of Afsar Academy
pillarsSection.subtitle: Our philosophy centres on nurturing academic potential through structured principles that drive consistent results.

pillars.title: Quality Education
pillars.desc: Rigorous curriculum coverage with focused exam-oriented notes, chapter-wise assignments, and conceptual clarity.

pillars.title: Unwavering Dedication
pillars.desc: Special interest in every student's learning pace, doubt clearance, and personal academic mentorship.

pillars.title: Proven Success
pillars.desc: Over 98% pass rate across SSC, Intermediate, TOSS, BOSSE, and NIOS board examinations year after year.

title: Class IX & X (SSC / 10th Standard)
description: Comprehensive coaching for 9th & 10th Class students under Telangana State Board and CBSE. Focused on strong conceptual clarity, board exam preparations, and mock assessments.
features: Regular chapter-wise tests and mock board exams
Small batch sizes for maximum individual attention

title: Intermediate (Class XI & XII)
description: Thorough academic preparation for 1st & 2nd Year Intermediate across Science, Commerce, and Arts streams with focus on IPE board exam scoring.
boards: Telangana Board of Intermediate Education (TS BIE)
features: Special guidance for lab practicals & theory scoring
Regular progress tracking and parent updates

title: TOSS (Telangana Open School Society)
description: Direct admission and coaching for TOSS SSC (10th) and Intermediate (12th). Ideal for dropouts, working individuals, and direct year-saving candidates.
boards: Telangana Open School Society (Govt. of Telangana)
features: Flexible evening batch options for working students

title: BOSSE (Board of Open Schooling & Skill Education)
description: Flexibility in education with BOSSE 10th & 12th coaching. Nationally recognized open schooling board with skill-oriented curriculum options.
features: On-demand and annual exam coaching options
Fast-track guidance for higher education eligibility

title: NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling)
description: Expert coaching for NIOS 10th & 12th standards. Recognized by all Indian universities, competitive exams, and government jobs.
boards: NIOS (Ministry of Education, Govt. of India)
features: Practical exam preparation & record writing assistance
Special coaching for NEET/JEE eligible subjects

title: Degree Level Coaching
description: Targeted subject coaching for undergraduate university students (Osmania University and other major universities).
features: Coaching for Financial Accounting, Economics, Corporate Laws & Stats
Explanations focused on university exam patterns
Doubt clearing by senior degree lecturers

title: Class VI to VIII Foundation Tuitions
description: Strong foundational coaching in Mathematics, Science, English, and Social Studies to build academic confidence early.
features: Daily homework assistance and concept strengthening
